description: Creates a new Spring Boot project from the official Spring Initializr (start.spring.io) through the initialize_project tool. Use only when the user explicitly asks to create, scaffold, bootstrap or generate a new Spring Boot application in a new, absent directory. Never inside an existing Maven/Gradle project or into an existing target; to add code to an existing application use spring-boot-codegen.
